purpose: Fail-closed persistence protocol for Robustness Guardian, Alpha Synthesis, and Apex Council without transferring OMEGA or Infrastructure ownership.

startup.rule: Before substantive work, write IN_PROGRESS heartbeat with exact RUN_ID using fresh SHA and re-fetch it. Failure stops the run.

run_core.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted object keys; compact separators; preserve array order; no NaN/Infinity.

legacy.pre_v3_runs: May be preserved/reconciled as legacy evidence but are not v3 FINALIZATION_VERIFIED without a valid receipt.

secondary_backup.verification_rule: Library backup is VERIFIED only after exact RUN_ID artifact read-back and identity verification; failed/unavailable read-back must be UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED.
